proposed_record.reviewerRationale: Vard Marine addresses the naval-platform integration layer that sits above the container and its internal systems. Official design material shows multi-mission bays, containerized payload set-down areas, accommodation for up to four ISO containers, and plug-and-play mission-module handling in Canadian naval concepts. The public record must distinguish designs and approval-in-principle concepts from delivered vessels, but the evidence strongly supports Vard's ability to design container-ready naval architecture and a moderate derived connection to underwater ISR use cases.
